name: splitrun_2plus3_fast
description: 2+3 splitrun, FAST version: same technique as splitrun_2plus3 (one single split per turn, big half eats the partner's 3,083 backpiece, small half is fed into the partner's 9,250), but the geometry was re-solved with the turn limited to <= 20 ticks: 19 ticks = 0.76 s per turn instead of 2.5 s. 80 turns shown; tested 400 clean turns.
